subject: Credential flow trace + owner map for IAM audit
messages:
From: Dana Hart <dana.hart@nimbushealth.com>
To: vivek_kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>, irene_choi <irene@redwood.ai>, priyom_das <priyom@redwood.ai>
Cc: audit@veritassecurity.com
Date: 2026-10-21T09:12:00Z
Subject: Request: credential flow trace + owner mapping for upcoming SOC2 intake

Hi team,

We're kicking off our SOC2 readiness intake and Veritas (copied) asked us to provide a compact package demonstrating how Redwood handles credentialing/provisioning for Nimbus Health users. Specifically they want:

- A short end-to-end credential flow trace (SSO redirect -> SAML assertion -> local session creation -> SCIM provisioning event) for a sample user.
- A SCIM delta sample showing user create/update/delete and which attributes drive role assignments.
- A role ownership map (owners for each high-priv role) + brief justification for any non-minimal roles.
- A signed owner attestation template we can include in the audit binder.

Timeline: Veritas asked for these artifacts by COB Friday, Oct 23. Can you confirm what's feasible and what format you'll deliver? If helpful, we can accept Drive links or zips.

Thanks — Dana
Dana Hart
Sr. Security Program Manager, Nimbus Health
[d: +1 415 555 0198]

From: vivek_kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>
To: Dana Hart <dana.hart@nimbushealth.com>
Cc: priyom_das <priyom@redwood.ai>, irene_choi <irene@redwood.ai>, Audit Team <audit@veritassecurity.com>
Date: 2026-10-21T11:03:00Z
Subject: Re: Request: credential flow trace + owner mapping for upcoming SOC2 intake

Dana — thanks for the clear list. We can deliver a concise bundle by your cutoff. Quick clarifying points so we scope correctly:

1) For the credential flow trace: do you want a single end-to-end trace for a production-like tenant or an anonymized sandbox run? We can provide both, but production traces need redaction.
2) For role ownership: we'll include owners for roles that grant "admin" or "write" to customer-sensitive resources; do you also want owners for service accounts?
3) Attestation: we can provide the owner-attestation-template (attached) and collect one signed signature per owner; if you need consolidated PDF evidence, say so.

Plan: I will coordinate collection. Priyom will drop a SCIM delta sample + role matrix. Irene will add a SAML assertion example and a short step-by-step of the trace (kernel timestamps + request IDs). I'll compile into a single Drive folder and share the link back to Veritas.

We will attach quick provenance notes (timestamps, request ids) to make it auditable.

-Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Trust & Safety, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: owner-attestation-template.docx (DOCX, 18KB)]

From: priyom_das <priyom@redwood.ai>
To: vivek_kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>, Dana Hart <dana.hart@nimbushealth.com>
Cc: irene_choi <irene@redwood.ai>, Audit Team <audit@veritassecurity.com>
Date: 2026-10-22T08:26:00Z
Subject: Re: Request: credential flow trace + owner mapping for upcoming SOC2 intake

Vivek / Dana — attaching the SCIM delta sample and the role ownership matrix. Quick notes below: 

- SCIM delta file includes three events (create, replace, deactivate) for a demo user "nimbus_demo_01". Columns: timestamp_utc, request_id, op_type, id, externalId, userName, emails, groups, mappedRole. We included the attribute that triggers role mapping ("department" -> mappedRole).
- Role matrix includes owners (email aliases), last attestation date, and minimal-priv justification where a role has broader scope.

On Wed, Oct 21, 2026 at 11:03 AM Vivek Kulkarni wrote:
> Dana — thanks for the clear list. We can deliver a concise bundle by your cutoff.

Let me know if you want CSV or NDJSON; CSV attached per your earlier asks.

- Priyom
Senior Platform Reliability Engineer, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: scim-delta-sample.csv (CSV, 34KB)]
[Attachment: role-ownership-matrix.xlsx (XLSX, 48KB)]

From: irene_choi <irene@redwood.ai>
To: vivek_kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>, priyom_das <priyom@redwood.ai>, Dana Hart <dana.hart@nimbushealth.com>
Cc: Audit Team <audit@veritassecurity.com>
Date: 2026-10-22T14:17:00Z
Subject: Re: Request: credential flow trace + owner mapping for upcoming SOC2 intake

Folks — attaching the SAML assertion example and a short trace extract from our staging tenant. Key points: 

- SAML assertion example (saml-assertion-example.xml) is redacted for PII; it includes the NameID, Audience, AuthnInstant, and custom attributes used by our SP to correlate to the SCIM identity.
- Trace extract: I included request IDs and kernel timestamps for the OIDC/SAML handoff, the session creation event (session_id), and the SCIM PATCH event used to add the initial role.
- Repro notes: run the staging flow with tenant id = "nimbus-stg-3"; the sequence is: 
  1) IdP -> /sso/saml/acs (SAML POST)
  2) our auth service validates and issues session token (session_id)
  3) provisioner consumes mapping and issues SCIM PATCH to /scim/v2/Users/{id}

I also included a suggested blurb for the attestation explaining how minimal privilege is enforced via attribute-driven mapping and periodic role reviews.

Thanks — Irene
Principal Security Engineer, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: saml-assertion-example.xml (XML, 6KB)]

From: Dana Hart <dana.hart@nimbushealth.com>
To: vivek_kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>
Cc: priyom_das <priyom@redwood.ai>, irene_choi <irene@redwood.ai>, Audit Team <audit@veritassecurity.com>
Date: 2026-10-23T17:45:00Z
Subject: Re: Request: credential flow trace + owner mapping for upcoming SOC2 intake

Team — this is excellent, thank you. Veritas reviewed the samples and the trace; a couple of tiny asks but nothing blocking: 

- Can you add the request_id -> trace_id mapping to the CSV headers for one event so we can link logs?
- For two roles flagged as "non-minimal" we need a one-line justification per role in the role matrix (you already have the justification column; please expand to one sentence each).

If you could drop an updated XLSX and CSV in the Drive folder before EOD, we'll mark this intake as delivered. I'll confirm with Veritas once they see the updated files.

Appreciate the quick turnaround.

Best,
Dana
